in_latin.name: Alexandr
in_latin.meaning: Latin name derived from Greek origin, meaning defender of the people
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Latinum a Graeco origine, significans defender populi. Alexandr erat nomen masculinum, quod a Graecorum gentibus usum est. Etymology: a- (privative) + lex (law) + andros (man). Origine: auctoritate Imperatoris Alexandri Magni, qui imperium Romanum extendit. In Ecclesia Christiana, nomen Alexandr significat protector populi Dei et servus Christi.

in_english.name: Alexandr
in_english.meaning: Latin name derived from Greek origin, meaning defender of the people, masculine name used in early Christian church
in_english.long_meaning: The name Alexandr is derived from the Greek names Alexander and Andros, meaning defender of the people. In the context of the early Christian church, the name Alexandr signifies a protector of God's people and a servant of Christ. The name has its origins in the authority of Emperor Alexander the Great, who extended the Roman Empire. The Greek roots a- (privative) and lex (law) combined with andros (man) convey a sense of protection and service. In Christian tradition, the name Alexandr is associated with qualities such as courage, leadership, and devotion to one's faith.

data.cultural_impact: The name Alexandr became popular in Eastern Europe and Russia due to the influence of the Greek, Roman, and Byzantine cultures. Numerous rulers, warriors, and saints throughout history bear this name, including Saint Alexander Nevsky, who is revered as a defender of Orthodox Christianity and Russia. Despite the passage of centuries, Alexandr remains a common name to this day, reflecting the enduring influence of these ancient civilizations and their cultural values.
data.spiritual_significance: Alexandr carries the reminder of its ancient root meaning - to defend. The name can inspire its bearer to protect what is dear to him, whether it be loved ones, beliefs, or principles. It also resonates with the broader theme of protection, reminding us of the divine protection that God offers and encourages us to embody as stewards of the world around us. Ultimately, the name Alexandr can serve as a reminder to stand up for truth, defend the vulnerable, and uphold what is good, demonstrating the fortitude of one's character.
